# NeoHtop

> NeoHtop is a free, MIT-licensed desktop system monitor for macOS, Linux, and Windows, built with Rust, Tauri, and Svelte. It monitors local processes and system resources without requiring an account.

The desktop app and NeoHtop CLI are separate projects. Desktop uses Rust/Tauri/Svelte; CLI uses Go and the Charm ecosystem. Do not infer feature parity between them.

Published desktop binaries are available only through GitHub Releases. The latest published release is authoritative for available packages and shipped features. The default branch includes development work: desktop process trees with family CPU/RAM and build/release compatibility improvements are intended for a future release and may not be present in published downloads.

NeoHtop Pro is in development. Remote monitoring, historical metrics, and alerts are being explored; final scope, pricing, and launch date are not announced. Pro cannot currently be purchased or installed. The free, open-source local monitor remains the project's foundation.

## Product information

- [NeoHtop overview](https://abdenasser.github.io/neohtop/index.md): Desktop features, project facts, development status, and official links.
- [Installation guide](https://abdenasser.github.io/neohtop/install.md): Platform and architecture selection, installation, and troubleshooting.
- [Desktop vs CLI](https://abdenasser.github.io/neohtop/desktop-vs-cli.md): Differences between the two applications.

- [Desktop source and README](https://github.com/Abdenasser/neohtop): Current development code and setup instructions.

- [MIT license](https://github.com/Abdenasser/neohtop/blob/main/LICENSE): Desktop license terms.

- [CLI source and README](https://github.com/Abdenasser/neohtop-cli): CLI-specific capabilities and installation.
- [CLI npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/neohtop-cli): Terminal companion package.
